faq.spamAnswer: No. Every email is sent directly from your own email account via SMTP — not from a shared bulk-sending server. Your customer sees your name, your email address, and a message written in your voice. It lands in the inbox like a personal note, not a marketing blast.
faq.providersAnswer: Any provider that supports SMTP works: Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, Apple iCloud Mail, cPanel/Zoho business email, and virtually any hosting provider's mail server. If you can set up an email app on your phone, you can connect it to Get Phame.
faq.freeAnswer: Yes — free with no artificial sending limits. You connect your own email account, so the only limit is your email provider's daily sending cap (Gmail allows ~500/day, most others are similar). There are no hidden fees and no credit card required to get started.
faq.importQuestion: Can I import my customer list?
faq.importAnswer: Yes. You can upload a CSV file with your customers' names and email addresses, or sync directly from WooCommerce if you run an online store. Once imported, you can bulk-select contacts and send personalised review requests in a single click.
faq.a1: No. Every email is sent directly from your own email account via SMTP — not from a shared bulk-sending server. Your customer sees your name, your email address, and a message written in your voice.
faq.a2: Any provider that supports SMTP works: Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo Mail, Apple iCloud Mail, cPanel/Zoho business email, and virtually any hosting provider's mail server.
faq.a3: Yes — free with no artificial sending limits. You connect your own email account, so the only limit is your email provider's daily sending cap.

smtp.title: Email Connection (SMTP)
smtp.description: Connect your own email account to send review requests. We encrypt your password and never share it.
smtp.gmailGuideStep2: Turn on 2-Step Verification if not already on
smtp.gmailGuideStep3: Go to myaccount.google.com/apppasswords → name it Get Phame → click Create
smtp.gmailGuideStep4: Copy the 16-character code and paste it here — remove all spaces
smtp.gmailGuideTip: Tip: use a dedicated reviews@gmail.com account to keep your main inbox separate.
smtp.googleWorkspaceGuideStep1: Ask your Workspace admin to enable 2-Step Verification in admin.google.com
smtp.googleWorkspaceGuideStep2: Sign in to myaccount.google.com with your work account → Security
smtp.googleWorkspaceGuideStep3: Go to myaccount.google.com/apppasswords → name it Get Phame → click Create
smtp.googleWorkspaceGuideStep4: Copy the 16-character code and paste it here — remove all spaces
smtp.outlookGuideStep3: Under App passwords, click Create a new app password
smtp.outlookGuideStep4: Copy and paste the generated password here
smtp.outlookGuideTip: Microsoft 365 (work accounts): contact your IT admin to allow SMTP AUTH for your mailbox.
smtp.yahooGuideStep3: Select Other app, name it Get Phame
smtp.yahooGuideStep4: Copy and paste the password here
smtp.zohoGuideStep3: Click your email address → scroll to SMTP
smtp.zohoGuideStep4: Toggle Allow SMTP Access to ON, then use your regular Zoho password here
smtp.zohoGuideTip: No app password needed — just enable SMTP and use your normal Zoho login password.
smtp.aolGuideStep3: Select Other app, name it Get Phame
smtp.aolGuideStep4: Copy and paste the password here — do not use your regular AOL password
smtp.aolGuideTip: AOL requires 2-step verification to be enabled before generating app passwords.
smtp.protonMailGuideStep1: Download and install Proton Mail Bridge from proton.me/mail/bridge
smtp.protonMailGuideStep2: Sign in to Bridge with your Proton account
smtp.protonMailGuideStep3: In Bridge, click your account → copy the SMTP password shown
smtp.protonMailGuideStep4: Paste that SMTP password here — not your regular Proton login password
smtp.protonMailTip: ProtonMail Bridge must be running on your computer for SMTP to work. Use port 1025 (localhost) or 587 via Bridge.
smtp.fastmailGuideStep1: Go to app.fastmail.com → Settings → Privacy & Security
smtp.fastmailGuideStep2: Click App passwords → New app password
smtp.fastmailGuideStep3: Name it Get Phame, select SMTP, then click Generate password
smtp.fastmailGuideStep4: Copy and paste the generated password here
smtp.iCloudGuideTitle: Apple iCloud Mail App Password — 4 steps
smtp.iCloudGuideStep1: Go to appleid.apple.com and sign in
smtp.iCloudGuideStep2: Under Sign-In and Security, click App-Specific Passwords
smtp.iCloudGuideStep3: Click Generate an app-specific password..., name it Get Phame, click Create
smtp.iCloudGuideStep4: Copy the xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx password and paste it here
smtp.iCloudTip: Two-factor authentication must be enabled for your Apple ID.

clientDetailSheet.title: Client Detail Sheet
clientDetailSheet.description: Tap any client name in the dashboard to open a full detail view: see the exact email that was sent, edit the subject and body, restart the campaign, or view the full reminder timeline.

bulkRestart.title: Bulk Restart Campaigns
bulkRestart.description: Select multiple non-responding clients in the dashboard and restart all their review request campaigns in one action. Pending reminders are automatically rescheduled.

yelpCompliance.title: Yelp Compliance Mode
yelpCompliance.description: Yelp review links now render as plain-text instructions instead of clickable links, keeping your outreach fully compliant with Yelp's no-solicitation policy.

domainMigration.title: New Home: getphame.app
domainMigration.description: Phame has officially moved to getphame.app. All existing links, emails, and integrations have been updated automatically.

emailDashboard.title: Email Performance Dashboard
emailDashboard.description: Open rate and click rate now appear as an at-a-glance summary card on your Home screen, so you can see how your review requests are performing without digging into individual records.

topTemplateBadge.title: Top Template Badge
topTemplateBadge.description: The email template with the highest click rate now shows a gold 🏆 Top Template badge on the Templates list, so you always know which message is converting best.

reminderTracking.title: Reminder Email Tracking
reminderTracking.description: Open and click tracking now covers reminder follow-up emails, not just the initial send. All engagement data rolls up under the original request so your stats stay clean.

referralCard.title: Share Get Phame Referral Card
referralCard.description: A new card on the Home screen lets you share Get Phame with other local businesses in one tap — using the native share sheet on mobile or clipboard copy on desktop.

csvImport.title: CSV Contact Import
csvImport.description: Import your entire customer list from a spreadsheet in four steps: upload, map columns, preview, and confirm. Supports up to 5,000 contacts per import with automatic duplicate detection.

bulkSend.title: Bulk Send to Contacts
bulkSend.description: Select multiple saved contacts and send review requests in one action. Daily send limits apply to keep your deliverability healthy.

wooSync.title: WooCommerce Customer Sync
wooSync.description: Connect your WooCommerce store and automatically import customers from completed orders. Sync runs on demand or on a schedule.

emailTracking.title: Email Open & Click Tracking
emailTracking.description: See exactly which customers opened your review request and who clicked the link. Per-request tracking data appears in the Send History drawer.

reminders.title: Follow-up Reminders
reminders.description: Automatically schedule a follow-up email 3 days after the initial review request for customers who haven't responded yet.

multiPlatform.title: Multi-Platform Review Links
multiPlatform.description: Add multiple review destinations (Google, Yelp, TripAdvisor, Facebook) and let customers choose where to leave their review.

compliance.title: Compliance Guide
compliance.description: Built-in compliance guide covers FTC rules, platform-specific policies, and best practices for ethical review solicitation.

launch.title: Get Phame Launch
launch.description: Send personalised review request emails from your own email account — not a bulk mailer. Customers receive a message that looks like it came directly from you.
